about: Hand-written sample in the shape of an SSPX Ordo year response, for testing scripts/compare-ordo.mjs. It is not Ordo data: 26 March agrees with the engine, 27 March names a different St. John, 12 July has the wrong Sunday number, and every other day is absent.
